tiles.title: Failed traces %
tiles.description: Traces with at least one error span.

tiles.title: Fabric RTI
tiles.markdownText:
[Metrics]({{url:metrics}}) · [Logs]({{url:logs}}) · **Traces**

Pick a trace in **Trace**, paste one from Logs into **Trace ID**, or right-click a TraceID in *Find a trace* → **Cross-filter**. Red bars in the waterfall failed.

tiles.title: Calls by dependency
tiles.description: Caller → callee hops derived from parent/child spans, in request order. Green calls succeeded, red calls failed.

tiles.title: Find a trace
tiles.description: Up to 100 traces ordered by Trace list, or only the pasted Trace ID. Right-click a TraceID → Cross-filter to draw it.

tiles.title: Trace waterfall
tiles.description: Spans of the selected trace on a shared timeline, in start order. Each bar starts when its span starts; red bars failed. Hover a bar for its duration, or the gap before it for its start offset. Logs per span are in the table below.

tiles.title: p95 self time by operation (ms)
tiles.description: Span duration minus time spent in child spans: where the latency is actually spent.

parameters.description: Deployment environment reported by the OpenTelemetry resource.
Ordering of Find a trace and the Trace picker.
Trace drawn in the waterfall. Defaults to the newest complete trace; Trace ID overrides it.
Paste a TraceID, for example from the Logs dashboard. While set, it overrides Trace and filters Find a trace to that trace. Clear it to use the picker again.

queries.text:
OTELTraces
| where StartTime between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| distinct Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| order by Environment asc

OTELTraces
| where StartTime between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where (isempty(_environment) or Environment in (_environment))
| summarize Start=min(StartTime), Finish=max(EndTime), Spans=count(), Roots=countif((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")),
    ErrorSpans=countif(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR"), MatchingService=countif((isempty(_service) or Service in (_service))),
    Root=take_anyif(strcat(Service, " ", SpanName), (isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")), Services=make_set(Service, 16),
    Ids=make_set(SpanID, 128), Parents=make_set_if(ParentID, not((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")), 128)
    by TraceID, Environment
| where MatchingService > 0
| extend DurationMs=round((Finish - Start) / 1ms, 1)
| where Roots > 0 and Spans > 1 and array_length(set_difference(Parents, Ids)) == 0
| where _trace_view != "errors" or ErrorSpans > 0
| extend Settled=iff(Start < ago(1m), 1, 0)
| extend Rank=iff(_trace_view == "slowest", DurationMs, (Start - datetime(1970-01-01)) / 1ms)
| order by Settled desc, Rank desc
| take 500
| project TraceID, Label=strcat(TraceID, " · ", format_datetime(Start, "HH:mm:ss"), " · ", Root, " · ",
    tolong(DurationMs), " ms · ", iff(ErrorSpans > 0, "Error", "OK"))

OTELTraces
| where StartTime between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where (isempty(_environment) or Environment in (_environment))
| summarize Start=min(StartTime), Finish=max(EndTime), Spans=count(), Roots=countif((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")),
    ErrorSpans=countif(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR"), MatchingService=countif((isempty(_service) or Service in (_service))),
    Root=take_anyif(strcat(Service, " ", SpanName), (isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")), Services=make_set(Service, 16),
    Ids=make_set(SpanID, 128), Parents=make_set_if(ParentID, not((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")), 128)
    by TraceID, Environment
| where MatchingService > 0
| extend DurationMs=round((Finish - Start) / 1ms, 1)
| summarize Traces=count(), Failed=countif(ErrorSpans > 0), P95TraceMs=percentile(DurationMs, 95),
    SpansPerTrace=avg(Spans)
| project Traces, FailedPercent=round(iff(Traces == 0, real(null), 100.0 * Failed / Traces), 2),
    P95TraceMs=round(P95TraceMs, 0), SpansPerTrace=round(SpansPerTrace, 1)

let spans = materialize(OTELTraces
| where StartTime between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where (isempty(_environment) or Environment in (_environment))
| project TraceID, SpanID, ParentID, Service, SpanName, SpanKind, SpanStatus, DurationMs=(EndTime - StartTime) / 1ms);
let calls = union
    (spans
    | where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_SERVER" and not((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000"))
    | join kind=inner (spans | project TraceID, ParentID=SpanID, Caller=Service) on TraceID, ParentID
    | where Caller != Service
    | project source=Caller, target=Service, SpanStatus, DurationMs),
    (spans
    | where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_CLIENT" and SpanName startswith "demo.postgres"
    | project source=Service, target="postgres", SpanStatus, DurationMs)
| where isempty(_service) or source in (_service) or target in (_service);
calls
| summarize Calls=count(), Errors=countif(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR") by source, target
| extend Hop=array_index_of(dynamic(["gateway", "checkout", "inventory", "payment", "shipping", "notifications", "postgres"]), target)
| order by Hop asc, source asc
| project Dependency=strcat(source, " → ", target), ["calls/min ok"]=round((Calls - Errors) / max_of(1.0, (_endTime - _startTime) / 1m), 1),
    ["calls/min failed"]=round(Errors / max_of(1.0, (_endTime - _startTime) / 1m), 1)
| take 100

let spans = materialize(OTELTraces
| where StartTime between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where (isempty(_environment) or Environment in (_environment))
| project TraceID, SpanID, ParentID, Service, SpanName, SpanKind, SpanStatus, DurationMs=(EndTime - StartTime) / 1ms);
let calls = union
    (spans
    | where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_SERVER" and not((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000"))
    | join kind=inner (spans | project TraceID, ParentID=SpanID, Caller=Service) on TraceID, ParentID
    | where Caller != Service
    | project source=Caller, target=Service, SpanStatus, DurationMs),
    (spans
    | where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_CLIENT" and SpanName startswith "demo.postgres"
    | project source=Service, target="postgres", SpanStatus, DurationMs)
| where isempty(_service) or source in (_service) or target in (_service);
calls
| summarize Calls=count(), Errors=countif(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR"), P95Ms=percentile(DurationMs, 95)
    by Caller=source, Callee=target
| extend Hop=array_index_of(dynamic(["gateway", "checkout", "inventory", "payment", "shipping", "notifications", "postgres"]), Callee)
| order by Hop asc
| project Caller, Callee, CallsPerMinute=round(Calls / max_of(1.0, (_endTime - _startTime) / 1m), 1), ErrorPercent=round(100.0 * Errors / Calls, 2),
    P95Ms=round(P95Ms, 1)
| take 100

let pasted_trace = tolower(trim(@"\s+", _trace_lookup));
OTELTraces
| where StartTime between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where (isempty(_environment) or Environment in (_environment))
| summarize Start=min(StartTime), Finish=max(EndTime), Spans=count(), Roots=countif((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")),
    ErrorSpans=countif(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR"), MatchingService=countif((isempty(_service) or Service in (_service))),
    Root=take_anyif(strcat(Service, " ", SpanName), (isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")), Services=make_set(Service, 16),
    Ids=make_set(SpanID, 128), Parents=make_set_if(ParentID, not((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")), 128)
    by TraceID, Environment
| where MatchingService > 0
| extend DurationMs=round((Finish - Start) / 1ms, 1)
| where isempty(pasted_trace) or TraceID == pasted_trace
| where _trace_view != "errors" or ErrorSpans > 0
| extend Rank=iff(_trace_view == "slowest", DurationMs, (Start - datetime(1970-01-01)) / 1ms)
| top 100 by Rank desc
| extend Hops=array_sort_asc(Services)
| project Start, TraceID, Root=iff(isempty(Root), "(root pending)", Root), Status=iff(ErrorSpans > 0, "Error", "OK"),
    DurationMs, Spans, Services=strcat_array(Hops, ", "), Environment

let pasted_trace = tolower(trim(@"\s+", _trace_lookup));
let selected_trace = iff(isempty(pasted_trace), _trace_id, pasted_trace);
let spans = materialize(OTELTraces
| where StartTime between ((_startTime - 5m) .. (_endTime + 5m))
| where TraceID == selected_trace
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), ParentID=iff(ParentID == "0000000000000000", "", ParentID)
| take 500);
let t0 = toscalar(spans | summarize min(StartTime));
let traced = materialize(spans
| extend P1=ParentID
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P1=SpanID, P2=ParentID) on P1
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P2=SpanID, P3=ParentID) on P2
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P3=SpanID, P4=ParentID) on P3
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P4=SpanID, P5=ParentID) on P4
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P5=SpanID, P6=ParentID) on P5
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P6=SpanID, P7=ParentID) on P6
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P7=SpanID, P8=ParentID) on P7
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P8=SpanID, P9=ParentID) on P8
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P9=SpanID, P10=ParentID) on P9
| extend Depth=toint(isnotempty(P1)) + toint(isnotempty(P2)) + toint(isnotempty(P3)) + toint(isnotempty(P4)) + toint(isnotempty(P5)) + toint(isnotempty(P6)) + toint(isnotempty(P7)) + toint(isnotempty(P8)) + toint(isnotempty(P9)) + toint(isnotempty(P10))
| project-away P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9, P10
| extend OffsetMs=round((StartTime - t0) / 1ms, 1), DurationMs=round((EndTime - StartTime) / 1ms, 1)
| order by StartTime asc, Depth asc
| extend Row=row_number() - 1);
traced
| extend Op=replace_string(SpanName, "demo.", ""), Failed=SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR"
| extend Label=strcat(iff(Depth > 0, "└ ", ""), Service, iff(Op == Service, "", strcat(" · ", Op)))
| order by Label asc, Row asc
| extend Nth=row_number(1, Label != prev(Label))
| extend Span=iff(Nth > 1, strcat(Label, " (", Nth, ")"), Label)
| order by Row asc
| project Span, ["start offset (ms)"]=OffsetMs, ["span duration (ms)"]=iff(Failed, 0.0, DurationMs),
    ["failed span duration (ms)"]=iff(Failed, DurationMs, 0.0)

let pasted_trace = tolower(trim(@"\s+", _trace_lookup));
let selected_trace = iff(isempty(pasted_trace), _trace_id, pasted_trace);
let spans = materialize(OTELTraces
| where StartTime between ((_startTime - 5m) .. (_endTime + 5m))
| where TraceID == selected_trace
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), ParentID=iff(ParentID == "0000000000000000", "", ParentID)
| take 500);
let t0 = toscalar(spans | summarize min(StartTime));
let traced = materialize(spans
| extend P1=ParentID
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P1=SpanID, P2=ParentID) on P1
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P2=SpanID, P3=ParentID) on P2
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P3=SpanID, P4=ParentID) on P3
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P4=SpanID, P5=ParentID) on P4
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P5=SpanID, P6=ParentID) on P5
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P6=SpanID, P7=ParentID) on P6
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P7=SpanID, P8=ParentID) on P7
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P8=SpanID, P9=ParentID) on P8
| lookup kind=leftouter (spans | project P9=SpanID, P10=ParentID) on P9
| extend Depth=toint(isnotempty(P1)) + toint(isnotempty(P2)) + toint(isnotempty(P3)) + toint(isnotempty(P4)) + toint(isnotempty(P5)) + toint(isnotempty(P6)) + toint(isnotempty(P7)) + toint(isnotempty(P8)) + toint(isnotempty(P9)) + toint(isnotempty(P10))
| project-away P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9, P10
| extend OffsetMs=round((StartTime - t0) / 1ms, 1), DurationMs=round((EndTime - StartTime) / 1ms, 1)
| order by StartTime asc, Depth asc
| extend Row=row_number() - 1);
let span_logs = OTELLogs
    | where Timestamp between ((_startTime - 5m) .. (_endTime + 5m))
    | where TraceID == selected_trace
    | summarize Logs=count() by SpanID;
traced
| join kind=leftouter span_logs on SpanID
| order by Row asc
| project Span=strcat(strrep("\u00a0\u00a0\u00a0", Depth), iff(Depth > 0, "└ ", ""), Service, " · ", SpanName),
    Kind=tolower(replace_string(SpanKind, "SPAN_KIND_", "")), StartOffsetMs=OffsetMs, DurationMs,
    Status=iff(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR", "Error", "OK"), StatusMessage=SpanStatusMessage,
    Logs=coalesce(Logs, 0), Service, SpanID

let pasted_trace = tolower(trim(@"\s+", _trace_lookup));
let selected_trace = iff(isempty(pasted_trace), _trace_id, pasted_trace);
OTELLogs
| where Timestamp between ((_startTime - 5m) .. (_endTime + 5m))
| where TraceID == selected_trace
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Scenario=tostring(LogsAttributes["demo.scenario"]),
    Outcome=tostring(LogsAttributes["outcome"])
| order by Timestamp asc
| take 200
| project Timestamp, Level=SeverityText, Service, Message=strcat("[", Service, "] ", Body, " (", Scenario, ", ", Outcome, ")"), SpanID

let step = max_of(1m, bin((_endTime - _startTime) / 90, 1m));
OTELTraces
| where StartTime between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where (isempty(_environment) or Environment in (_environment))
| summarize Start=min(StartTime), Finish=max(EndTime), Spans=count(), Roots=countif((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")),
    ErrorSpans=countif(SpanStatus == "STATUS_CODE_ERROR"), MatchingService=countif((isempty(_service) or Service in (_service))),
    Root=take_anyif(strcat(Service, " ", SpanName), (isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")), Services=make_set(Service, 16),
    Ids=make_set(SpanID, 128), Parents=make_set_if(ParentID, not((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000")), 128)
    by TraceID, Environment
| where MatchingService > 0
| extend DurationMs=round((Finish - Start) / 1ms, 1)
| summarize ok=round(countif(ErrorSpans == 0) / (step / 1m), 1), failed=round(countif(ErrorSpans > 0) / (step / 1m), 1)
    by WindowStart=bin(Start, step)
| order by WindowStart asc

let spans = materialize(OTELTraces
| where StartTime between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where ResourceAttributes["demo.synthetic"] == true
| extend Service=tostring(ResourceAttributes["service.name"]), Environment=tostring(ResourceAttributes["deployment.environment.name"])
| where (isempty(_environment) or Environment in (_environment))
| project TraceID, SpanID, ParentID, Service, SpanName, DurationMs=(EndTime - StartTime) / 1ms);
let child_time = spans
    | where not((isempty(ParentID) or ParentID == "0000000000000000"))
    | summarize ChildMs=sum(DurationMs) by TraceID, SpanID=ParentID;
spans
| join kind=leftouter child_time on TraceID, SpanID
| extend SelfMs=max_of(0.0, DurationMs - coalesce(ChildMs, 0.0))
| where (isempty(_service) or Service in (_service))
| summarize P95SelfMs=round(percentile(SelfMs, 95), 1) by Operation=strcat(Service, " · ", SpanName)
| top 10 by P95SelfMs desc
